historical_fine_art.visual_characteristics: Thick impasto 3D paint relief, canvas weave, chiaroscuro shading, fine brushstrokes.
historical_fine_art.forensic_challenge: Impasto texture and canvas grain produce elevated high-frequency residuals that trigger false alarms in naive wavelet/SRM detectors.
historical_fine_art.phase_incorporation_plan: Phase 1: Validated baseline on COCO; Phase 2: Unpack 15,000 WikiArt samples into the active training stream with asymmetric FP penalty.

complex_camera_photography.visual_characteristics: Localized optical glare, heavy JPEG compression block boundaries, high-contrast backlit edges.
complex_camera_photography.forensic_challenge: Compression block artifacts can resemble diffusion upsampling deconvolution grid boundaries.

high_resolution_raw_photos.visual_characteristics: Ultra-sharp optical sensor grain, fine hair and skin textures, macro photography.
high_resolution_raw_photos.forensic_challenge: Sensor ISO noise must be distinguished from score-matching stochastic noise.

social_media_compressed_web.visual_characteristics: Aggressive messaging platform compression (WhatsApp, WeChat transcode), low bitrate.
social_media_compressed_web.forensic_challenge: Severe lossy transcode removes high-frequency details, testing semantic ViT robustness.
